title: Evaluation formula for the canonical internal compact-support adjunction
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, let $f:X\to S$ be compactifiable [def-asd-compactifiable] between Noetherian schemes, and work in the ordinary unbounded etale derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], with derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor] and internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Let $M\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $K,Q\in D(S_{\mathrm{et}},A)$. Write $\alpha_{f,M,K}:Rf_*R\mathcal Hom_A(M,f^\times K)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\mathcal Hom_A(Rf_!M,K)$ for the canonical internal adjunction [prop-asd-internal-adjunction], with $Rf_!$ the ordinary etale compact direct image [def-amb-etale-compact-support] and $f^\times$ its right adjoint [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint], and $\varepsilon_{f,K}:Rf_!f^\times K\to K$ for the exceptional counit. For a map $h:Q\to Rf_*R\mathcal Hom_A(M,f^\times K)$ let $p:f^*Q\otimes_A^L M\to f^\times K$ be its transpose under ordinary inverse-image and tensor--Hom adjunction. The tensor--Hom transpose of $\alpha_{f,M,K}\circ h$ is precisely
$$Q\otimes_A^L Rf_!M\xrightarrow{\Pi_{f,Q,M}}Rf_!(f^*Q\otimes_A^L M)\xrightarrow{Rf_!(p)}Rf_!f^\times K\xrightarrow{\varepsilon_{f,K}}K.$$
Here $\Pi_{f,Q,M}$ is the canonical compact-support projection isomorphism: for a compactification $f=rj$, first apply the proper counit-defined projection map of [lem-amb-proper-coproducts-projection], then the extension-by-zero tensor identification [lem-pur-etale-open-derived-tensor] $r^*Q\otimes_A^L j_!M\cong j_!(f^*Q\otimes_A^L M)$. This normalizes the displayed map on the ambient ordinary etale categories; it makes no constructibility assertion.
